_comment: Named lat/lon boxes for tools/fetch-geodata.mjs. Derivations are recorded so they can be recomputed from data.

slice.derivation: Bounding box of active CALIFORNIA ST centreline points between HYDE ST and DRUMM ST (DataSF 3psu-pn9h, 2026-10-22), expanded 500 m north/south, 250 m west, 350 m east (to include the Ferry Building). 2.33 x 1.28 km.

core.derivation: Union of the bounding boxes (SoQL extent(line)) of active centreline segments by analysis_neighborhood (DataSF 3psu-pn9h, 2026-10-22): Russian Hill, Nob Hill, Chinatown, Financial District/South Beach, North Beach (Telegraph Hill, Fisherman's Wharf), Tenderloin (Union Square, Civic Center), South of Market; expanded 300 m on every side (300/111132 deg lat, 300/(111320 cos 37.7896) deg lon). 4.03 x 5.35 km.

landmarks.derivation: Hand-set (P5.1): a box round San Francisco's land and both bridges end to end (the Golden Gate Bridge to its Marin anchorage, the Bay Bridge to its Oakland touchdown), for the named landmark query (tools/queries/landmarks-named.overpassql) and the DEM tiles under landmarks outside the core. Not a build box: nothing else is fetched for it.

city.derivation: P6 city coverage: SF peninsula to its southern boundary, Treasure and Yerba Buena islands. Full DataSF geometry is retained for intersecting features.

horizon.derivation: P6 horizon extent covering Marin Headlands, Angel Island and the East Bay, within USGS 1/3 arc-second tile n38w123.
